correctness.rationale: The edge-sharing triangle cover forces any adjacent selected pair to fill the graph; a distance-two pair forces adjacency. The cyclic gap check is exhaustive for all pairs within graph distance <=2. Its weighted 2x2 transition matrix gives a formal log-determinant trace identity, explicitly differentiated to the rational function; alternating short gaps yield the sharp max floor(2n/5). Standalone independent implementations of local convexity, distance-two packing, symbolic coefficient recurrence and cyclic ternary words agree through stated ranges.

value.rationale: Exact all-order cardinality enumeration of P3-convex sets on the natural 4-regular planar antiprism family is a motivated positive special case of recent #P-complete convexity counting. It gives a compact rational bivariate series, an explicit structural equivalence to distance-two packings and a sharp maximum proper-convex-set density of 2/5, none being a mere finite re-tabulation.
